## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any limitations. Include screenshots for visible
changes, using synthetic progress only.

## Review

- [ ] The change preserves existing player progress and compatibility, where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and meaningful regression checks are updated as needed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal exports, private emails, or local user paths are included.
- [ ] Asset provenance and existing license notices are preserved.
